purpose: Engineering edge cases and prospective throughput only; no scientific tuning or natural sequence training

data.sequence_rule: Deterministic rotation of the canonical20 AA alphabet; lengths cycle1,5,47,48; no real sequence content
data.posterior_rule: Synthetic mu fingerprint varying row,channel,position; synthetic logsigma fixed -1; float32[279,16,48]
data.rng: Private CPU generators for fixtures; no global natural-run RNG consumption. Where testing frozen initial_models/uniform_bank, fork RNG and discard every synthetic weight/output.

benchmark_contract: A/B training includes complete279x16x48 epsilon draw and sampled-z digest at every update, same-terminal whole-row derangement for B, shared batch indices, backward/Adam/clip and flushed trace write; C runs same batches without z.
All100 training steps per arm, not best subset; interrupted or failed benchmark blocks admission until cause is reported. No natural retry authorization follows from a benchmark repair.

Dev shapes are one entire batch41 and generation one entire batch32. Execute the upper-bound49 one-token steps per condition by a synthetic driver so earlyEOS cannot understate runtime; this driver does not alter candidate natural decoding.
Capture representative final checkpoint/raw-array serialization and full fixed-size scoring on deterministic synthetic sequences, including normalized Levenshtein against279 synthetic references.
Functional decode edge cases use scripted fake logits, separate from actual-AR forward count; verify EOS/absorbing/uniform/failure behavior deterministically without optimizer work.

prospective_admission_formula.interpretation: Conservative projection under observed load, not a runtime guarantee. Exact660 watchdog still governs once-only natural execution.

on_failure: Keep evidence, report BLOCKED and cause; do not expand scientific scope, natural budget, seeds or attempts.
execution_authorization: Root must explicitly open serial synthetic model window after candidate ready; no model import/forward is performed by this plan.
